# Inline Values Audit

**Generated file — do not edit by hand.** Rebuild with `python3 values_audit.py`.

Every row is a numeric literal in a guide that duplicates a global's value. The master copy lives in `skeleton_equations_micro.txt`; these copies have no link back to it, so they go stale silently. Converting the HIGH rows to global citations is what stops most guide edits from being necessary at all.

| Tier | Count | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| HIGH | 10 | ≥3 decimals or ≥4 digits — convert these first |
| MEDIUM | 86 | 2 decimals or 3-digit integer — usually a restatement |
| LOW | 783 | small integers / shared values — mostly prose, review individually |
| **Total** | **879** | across 118 sections |
